title: Fed minutes signal patience on rate cuts; equities retest highs
summary: FOMC participants leaned toward holding rates steady through summer, with one cut penciled in for September. Markets initially dipped before recovering.

title: Apple raises buyback to $120B, declares 7% dividend hike
summary: Apple's board approved a record $120B share repurchase authorization and increased the quarterly dividend by 7% to $0.27/share.

title: NVIDIA's Q1 data-center revenue tops $35B, beats by $4B
summary: NVDA reported $35.4B in Q1 data-center revenue vs $31.2B consensus. Guided Q2 above the high end of street estimates.

title: Treasury yields fall as core PCE comes in soft
summary: 10-year yield fell 12 basis points to 4.18% after March core PCE printed 0.2% MoM, slightly below the 0.25% consensus.

title: Microsoft's Copilot revenue run-rate hits $14B
summary: Disclosed in the post-earnings call: Copilot enterprise + consumer SKUs reached a $14B annualized run-rate, up 92% YoY.

title: Vanguard launches direct indexing for accounts under $500K
summary: Vanguard expanded its direct-indexing service to accounts as small as $50K, undercutting Charles Schwab's $250K threshold.

title: EM equities outperform as dollar weakens 2.4% YTD
summary: Emerging markets ETFs (VWO, IEMG) added 8.4% MTD as DXY pulled back 2.4% from January highs.

title: Real estate ETFs face pressure from refi wave delays
summary: REITs lagged broader equities in April as commercial-real-estate refinancing schedules extended into 2027 amid soft loan demand.
